tip.desc: Lilith moves like a shadow in the dark. Her passive skills help her move faster.
Aro excels in all kinds of melee weapons. His passive skills boost his attack power considerably.
Mace is the best tank with impressive defense skills against dinosaurs.
Magala possesses powerful healing skills. Her passive skills focus primarily on boosting healing which renders her more durable in battle.
This terrifying gun will scare the crap out of dinos AND your friends!
As deadly as it is costly, the Lava Cross is for professional dino hunters only.
A rifle wrapped in the skin of the mythical Twilight Reaver tells the world that you're no ordinary hunter.
Give those damn dinos a taste of hell!
Crafted from a meteorite cooled in a pool of dino tears, this gun is a master hunter's dream.
Forged from a volcano, this weapon is sure to deliver lethal damage to those dinos.
Forged from a pool of lava, this flamethrower will show those creatures real hell.
